import { z } from 'zod';
import { graphqlRequest } from '../../../api/graphql.js';
export const parseItems = (wire: unknown) => z.array(z.string()).safeParse(wire);
export async function loadItems() {
  const window = { start: 1, end: 2 };
  const wire = await graphqlRequest<{ document: unknown }>('query', window);
  return parseItems(wire.document);
}
